population.definition: all HTTP route declarations across all services

inspected.selection_rationale: routes touching money movement, authentication, or admin surfaces per census strata

coverage.method: ast-grep route extraction + targeted range reads

blind_spots.impact: authorisation posture of the GraphQL surface is undetermined

population.definition: request-handling modules in the web service

inspected.selection_rationale: top change-frequency x size files from census hotspots.csv

blind_spots.impact: scaling behaviour of background processing is unassessed

population.definition: inter-service call edges resolvable from static imports and HTTP client constructions

inspected.selection_rationale: edge set is small enough to enumerate in full; blast-radius claims depend on it being complete

coverage.method: static import graph + HTTP client call-site extraction

blind_spots.impact: edges resolved only at runtime via service-registry lookup are not represented, so blast radius is a lower bound
